convention: anchor: which real dimension the model's scale is matched against — 'height' matches the model's vertical (Y) raw size to the recorded height_cm; 'horizontal' matches the larger of the model's two horizontal (X/Z) raw sizes to the larger of recorded width_cm/depth_cm (used for beds and sofas, whose defining real-world measurement is length or width, not height). envelope: [maxLongCm, maxShortCm] — after anchoring, the footprint is shrunk (never enlarged) so neither horizontal side exceeds these bounds. This is a safety cap for badly-proportioned source files, not a routine corrector — most items never hit it.
